request.name: Anil Ambani
request.title: Businessperson
request.about:
Anil Dhirubhai Ambani (born 4 June 1959) is an Indian businessman, chairman, and managing director of Reliance Group (a.k.a. Reliance ADA Group). The Reliance Group was created in July 2006 following a demerger from Reliance Industries Limited. He led several listed corporations, including Reliance Capital, Reliance Infrastructure, Reliance Power, and Reliance Communications. Anil's net worth is currently estimated at $530 million as of March 10, 2025.

Ambani, once the sixth richest person in the world, declared bankruptcycy before a UK court in February 2020. He served in the Rajya Sabha, the upper house of the Parliament of India from Uttar Pradesh, as an Independent MP between 2004 and 2006.

events.event: Banned by SEBI from the securities market for five years and fined ₹25 crore over alleged diversion of funds from Reliance Home Finance
Declared his net worth to be zero in a UK court during a legal dispute over $700 million in unpaid debt to Chinese banks
Avoided a prison sentence for criminal contempt after paying ₹458 crore in guaranteed debts to Ericsson with financial assistance from his brother Mukesh Ambani
Reliance Power launched India's largest IPO at the time, which was fully subscribed within 60 seconds
Formed a major $1.2 billion joint venture between Reliance Entertainment and Steven Spielberg's DreamWorks Studios
Formally established the Reliance Anil Dhirubhai Ambani Group (ADA Group) following the demerger of Reliance Industries assets
Resigned from his position as an independent Member of Parliament in the Rajya Sabha
Reached a family settlement mediated by mother Kokilaben Ambani to split the Reliance empire between him and Mukesh Ambani
Entered the entertainment sector by acquiring a controlling stake in Adlabs Films (later renamed Reliance MediaWorks)
Elected to the Rajya Sabha as an independent Member of Parliament representing Uttar Pradesh with support from the Samajwadi Party
His father, Reliance Industries founder Dhirubhai Ambani, passed away without leaving a formal will, sparking a leadership conflict
Earned his MBA from the Wharton School of the University of Pennsylvania and joined Reliance Industries as Co-Chief Executive Officer
Born to Dhirubhai Ambani and Kokilaben Ambani in Mumbai, Maharashtra, India
